default.question: Do participants know they are being recorded?
default.answer: Always. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins a call, and you can attach a consent form to every invite.

default.question: Can participants join from a phone?
default.answer: Yes. They join your usual video call from any device, with nothing to install.

default.question: Which video tools does Fieldnote work with?
default.answer: Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. For in-person sessions, upload audio or video files from any phone or recorder.

default.question: Which languages can you transcribe?
default.answer: Thirty-two, including French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese. Highlights translate into English in one click.

default.question: Can we tag interviews with our own themes?
default.answer: Create your own tag sets for each project, or start from our templates for onboarding, churn and pricing research.

default.question: Who can see our interviews?
default.answer: Only people in your workspace. You decide who can watch full recordings and who only sees approved highlights.
